drums.tags: Funk-rock instrumental. A clean, compressed electric guitar plays a repetitive, syncopated single-note riff with occasional double-stops. The bass guitar follows the guitar riff closely with a percussive, slightly overdriven tone. Drums consist of a tight, dry snare and a consistent kick drum pattern. A second electric guitar provides rhythmic stabs with a wah-wah pedal effect. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E minor. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interlocking rhythmic relationship between the bass and the primary guitar riff.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[clean electric guitar syncopated riff enters]
[dry kick drum and snare enter]

[Main Section]
[percussive bass guitar enters, doubling the guitar riff]
[wah-wah electric guitar rhythmic stabs]
[steady 4/4 drum beat with tight snare hits]

[Bridge]
[bass guitar becomes more melodic with slides]
[wah-wah guitar increases frequency of stabs]

[Outro]
[instruments gradually fade out]
[final clean guitar chord]

bass.tags: Drum break, funk style. Acoustic drum kit with a dry, tight room sound. The kick drum features a short decay and emphasizes the fundamental frequency around 60Hz. The snare drum is tuned high with a crisp, metallic ring and prominent ghost notes between the primary backbeats. Hi-hats are played slightly open, creating a consistent sizzle on eighth-note subdivisions. The pattern utilizes syncopated kick placements on the 'and' of beats 1 and 3, while the snare maintains a steady backbeat on 2 and 4 with occasional syncopated accents. 105 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[four-bar drum break, dry acoustic kit]
[syncopated kick drum, ghost note snare accents]

[Main Section]
[steady hi-hat eighth notes with slight sizzle]
[snare backbeat on 2 and 4]
[kick drum syncopation on the off-beats]

[Outro]
[final snare hit with natural room decay]
